main.description: Tells one of the AppViews a user declared that a message behind one of the user's notifications was deleted or hidden, so it drops the notification and its pushed banner.

recipient.description: The user the call is about. Their social.colibri.beta.actor.appview record must list the receiving AppView.

message.description: The message whose notifications go away.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: NotDeclared
errors.description: The recipient's social.colibri.beta.actor.appview record doesn't list the receiving AppView.

errors.name: NotJoined
errors.description: The receiving AppView has no record of the recipient joining the community the call is about.

errors.name: NotManagingApp
errors.description: The calling AppView doesn't manage the community the call is about.

errors.name: FederationDisabled
errors.description: The receiving AppView doesn't federate with other AppViews.
